summary: Humphreys County tower (584 ft) listed as removed; a 1973 note on the survey mark it is tied to says no lookout tower was at that location.

facts.status_note: Tower removed. No source describes what, if anything, remains at the site.

events.note: Tennessee Valley Authority recovery note on survey mark FD1631 says there was no lookout tower at that location.

evidence.supports: tower HUT003 tied to mark FD1631; marked removed
mark set in the top of a concrete monument

RECOVERY NOTE BY TENNESSEE VALLEY AUTHORITY 1973

evidence.supports: about half a mile north of the Duck River
evidence.quote: IT IS 0.50 MI. NORTH OF DUCK RIVER

evidence.supports: no lookout tower at that location
evidence.quote: NOTE-NO LOOKOUT TOWER AT THIS LOCATION.

sources.title: NGS Data Sheet for survey mark FD1631 (DUCK)

notes_for_editor: The tower-to-mark tie rests on one list (tnlandforms: Info FD1631 removed). The NGS datasheet for FD1631 is named DUCK and its 1973 recovery note says no lookout tower was at the location; the sources do not say whether the tower ever stood on that exact mark. No build date, staffing or fire history found: checked the tnlandforms index and record, the NGS datasheet, the Humphreys County 1963 history on archive.org, and two web searches. Nothing describes the site today.
